label: framesOffByOne: an SVG export writes the frame after each one asked for
find: SVGExporter.export(scene: scene, frame: Double(frame), symbols: clean.symbols)
replace: SVGExporter.export(scene: scene, frame: Double(frame + 1), symbols: clean.symbols)

label: fileCommandsLeftOn: the window's file commands stay available headless
sceneOptionIgnored: an export always writes the selected scene
lastFrameRefused: the scene's last frame is outside the export's range
